samples.text_head: PGPE Ltd publishes September NAV | Company Announcement | Investegate Welcome Articles About Contact Us Help Home Companies Advanced search Archive Meetings UK Newswire New Login Register PGPE Ltd publishes September NAV Summary by AI BETA Close X PGPE Ltd's NAV per share rose 0.1% in September, with negative revaluations of -0.9% slightly offset by currency gains of +1.0%. International Schools Partnership (ISP) contributed +0.2% of Fund NAV driven by higher valuation EBITDA, a slight net debt reduction and a higher multiple, while Vishal Mega Mart detracted -0.4% of Fund NAV following share price weakness despite Q1 revenue growth of 19% and net profit up ~26%. The company invested EUR 2.3m in a direct co-investment signed prior to the managed wind-down vote; cash and cash equivalents were EUR 29.3m, ~3.8% of Fund NAV, with no notable distributions or exits.
